annotations.title: Can I afford this personal loan? (Dutch guideline)

description: Checks a personal loan or other consumer credit in the Netherlands against a conservative guideline: total credit repayments of at most about 15% of net monthly income. Returns the monthly instalment for the amount, rate and term, the room left, and whether it fits. A rule of thumb, not a lender decision; Dutch lenders use NIBUD/NVB tables and check BKR registration.

existing_monthly_debt_payments.description: Other monthly credit repayments (car lease, other loans). Default 0.

net_monthly_income.description: Net income per month in euros
